title: Member Profile
description: One household member who owns accounts and investments. The ID ('self'/'spouse') is the stable key, referenced by the 'owner' field in the owning accounts. Stored at data/members/<id>/profile.json. 'joint' ownership is a value but NOT a member entry — joint accounts live in data/members/household/ which has no profile.json.

id.description: Stable owner key referenced by accounts.json owner field

birth_date.description: Date of birth (ISO 8601). Used for age-based retirement/Social Security math.
